subject: Clarifying deployment priorities, SLA targets, and procurement owner
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@medisync.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sun, 07 Nov 2027 15:24:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo recap + clarifying deployment priorities and procurement owner

Hi Samantha — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our call and a couple of clarifying asks so we can put together a tailored proposal (technical + commercial):

- Top priorities you called out: PHI safety, predictable latency for triage path, and predictable unit cost for scaling pilots.
- Open items we need to confirm:
  1) Economic owner / decision approver for platform purchase (name + role).
  2) Target p95 latency for the inference path that will be on the critical path (you mentioned ~200–250ms; please confirm if that is end-to-end request-to-first-token or server-side generation only).
  3) Preferred deployment mode: Hosted (Redwood API), Dedicated (reserved GPU pool), or Private (VPC / on-prem). You mentioned wanting VPC for PHI — please confirm.
  4) SLA floor you need (availability and any per-request latency SLOs).
  5) Procurement cadence and the contact for contract/PO intake (email + expected review dates).

Attachments: I’ve attached our short overview deck and a sample commercial term sheet so procurement has context.

Next steps we propose once we have the confirmations above:
- We’ll prepare a short performance note (latency guidance and config: batching + caching suggestions) + a pricing estimate for the three deployment options.
- Draft SOW and proposed SLA language for initial pilot.
- Intro meeting with your economic owner + procurement next week if they’re available.

Could you confirm the items above by end of day Tuesday (Nov 9)? If easier, feel free to reply with a procurement contact and we’ll loop them in.

Thanks — excited to keep this moving.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: redwood-overview-deck.pdf; Medisync-procurement-intake.xlsx
From: Samantha Green <samantha.green@medisync.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Tom Hsu <thsu@medisync.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@medisync.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2027 10:12:30 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + clarifying deployment priorities and procurement owner

Thanks Sean — great demo and recap. Answers below:  

1) Economic owner: Tom Hsu, CTO (thsu@medisync.ai). He will make the final approval for the platform contract.
2) Latency target: p95 <= 200ms end-to-first-token for our product triage path (this includes network time to our VPC endpoint). For non-triage bulk scoring we can tolerate higher p95 (up to ~500ms).
3) Deployment: We’re leaning towards Private (VPC) given PHI scope and internal policy; however, we’re open to Dedicated if the latency guarantees are difficult to meet.
4) SLA: baseline expectation is 99.95% availability with an escalation path for incidents impacting triage traffic. Also need SOC 2 Type II evidence and basic penetration test summary.
5) Procurement: procurement@medisync.ai (primary intake). Typical review window is 2–3 weeks for a first-pass commercial review; legal will require a couple of scorecards before counters.

I’ve attached the procurement intake form we usually use (filled-in where helpful). Will loop Tom in for a short intro; can you propose times Wed/Thu next week for a 30-minute intro?

—Sam
Samantha Green
Head of Product Operations | Medisync Health
samantha.green@medisync.ai

Attachments: Medisync-procurement-intake.xlsx (filled)
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
To: sean.gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>, marcus.lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: rachel_kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Nov 2027 09:03:15 -0800
Subject: Internal: feasibility notes for Medisync p95=200ms ask

Quick internal note after reading Sam’s answers:
- p95 <= 200ms end-to-first-token including network to VPC is aggressive but achievable with the right topology. For Private we should propose:
  - Dedicated nodes (reserved GPU pool) colocated in their cloud region + edge routing to minimize network time.
  - KV cache / prefix caching for repeat prompts (will help p50/p95 on triage).
  - Model choice: recommend a quantized 8-bit variant with optimized kernels; provide both a latency-optimized and a quality-optimized config in the proposal.
- SLA: 99.95% is reasonable for Dedicated; for Private we’ll need to clarify whether Redwood will operate the control plane or they want a customer-managed control plane (affects SLA wording and support).

Action items for proposal:
- Sean: include a pricing estimate for Dedicated and Private (assume 2x reserved A100-equivalent nodes + bursting).
- Marcus: prepare a short perf note (expected p95 ranges by model/config) — 1 page.
- Rachel: prep SOC 2 summary + pen test abstract for attachment.

I’ll draft the internal guidance for legal on SLA language; once Sean gets procurement contact we can schedule the intro.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@medisync.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@medisync.ai>
Cc: Tom Hsu <thsu@medisync.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, marcus.lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>, rachel.kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + clarifying deployment priorities and procurement owner

Thanks Sam — this is super helpful. Confirming next steps and timeline from our side: 

- Intro call: I’ll schedule a 30-minicall with Tom + procurement for Thu Nov 11 or Fri Nov 12 — Marcus will join to cover performance and Laura will cover SLA/security.
- Pricing & perf packet: We’ll deliver a combined pricing estimate + 1-page perf note by end of day Nov 12. That packet will include Dedicated and Private options and an implementation checklist.
- Legal & SLA: Rachel will attach SOC 2 summary and a suggested SLA clause set for pilot. We’ll highlight control-plane responsibilities for Private deployments so your legal team can review.
- Draft SOW / contract: I’ll share a starter SOW and a DocuSign link for signature-ready documents after the intro call (target: Nov 18 for pilot kickoff contingent on approvals).

If procurement has an internal reference number they’d like on documents, please share it and we’ll include it in all materials.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — I’ll send calendar invites shortly.

Best,
—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
